subject: OrangeRails

criteria.label: Self-custody of your data (Bitcoin wallet sources)

summary: OrangeRails is the only option in this category that is simultaneously open source, Bitcoin-first, self-hostable, and built around a published open spec. On Bitcoin wallet sources your device seals your data before it ever leaves it, so we store ciphertext we cannot read: self-custody of your data. Bank connections are delegated to a licensed partner that holds the credential, so we never receive your bank login, and we do not claim self-custody of your data on that path.
